componentSets.name: SearchResultsPanel
componentSets.description: Global search results: GlobalSearch field with filter Tags, then results grouped by category with a See all Link per group. 4 variants: state (default, empty, no-results) × ghost (false, true), shipped as the used combinations. empty is before a query; no-results is after a query with zero hits; ghost=true is loading. Rows are ResultRow instances; the panel announces the result count on each change.

components.name: ResultRow
components.description: One hit in SearchResultsPanel: type icon, result title and helper text (path, owner or snippet). Single component. Swap the icon per result type; the whole row is one link. For command results use Command Item.
